name: cruise
description: Direct Codex coding workflows with a prompt-only request note.

interface.longDescription: Cruise starts a normal Codex task with the right-sized planning or coding guidance and keeps only the original request as a local note.
defaultPrompt: Use $cruise:build to plan a new project or major milestone.
